title: Pulse Creation Deck + Refinery Telemetry
page0: Redesign Pulse, heavily inspired by the provided unloaded Verse screenshot, into an elegant, intuitive creation instrument. Preserve all components and meticulous control; make tools/components browseable and creation/consumption apps immediately accessible. Make the system frictionless without losing fidelity. Verify that MOOR Refinery results are actually being used by instrumenting real usage statistics. Ask/seek through the Funnel, build it, and push it live.
correctedQuestion: How should Pulse organize creation, browsing, active apps, control, and measurable capability reuse so a person can continuously create with minimal navigation friction while retaining full access to every underlying component, parameter and provenance trail?
materialQuestions: What are the minimum persistent surfaces a creator needs at all times?
Which things are resources to browse, which are active instruments, and which are control/provenance layers?
How should the screenshot's floating spatial language become an interaction hierarchy rather than just a color theme?
How can components remain fully accessible without forcing a dense component grid onto the primary workspace?
How can input/consumption apps stay one gesture away without permanently occupying the workspace?
How should meticulous controls reveal progressively without hiding or deleting capability?
What objective events prove MOOR Refinery output is being consumed by the real request/build path?
Which reuse metrics indicate less repeated reasoning rather than merely more stored data?
How should the interface surface reuse/assembly statistics without becoming another dashboard?
How does the same layout degrade gracefully for a new user with few tools and scale for a user with thousands?

architecture.name: Pulse Creation Deck
architecture.rule: One spatial workspace surrounded by three lightweight access systems: Deck, Library, Inspector.

surfaces.title: Spatial Workspace
surfaces.purpose: Full-bleed active work. Windows/tools/components open here; nothing permanent boxes it in.

surfaces.title: Creation Deck
surfaces.purpose: A compact floating dock of pinned/recent runnable apps and creation instruments. One tap opens or focuses an app.
surfaces.rule: Apps that accept input or produce/consume results belong here, not buried in the component library.

surfaces.title: Component Library
surfaces.purpose: A slide-over/browser for all components, packages, generators, verified capabilities and compositions.
surfaces.interaction: drag/open/add-to-workspace; never forces permanent panel occupancy

surfaces.title: Context Inspector
surfaces.purpose: Progressive detail for the currently focused item: knobs, provenance, assembly, receipts, dependencies, tests and statistics.
surfaces.rule: Collapsed by default; full fidelity is one gesture away.

surfaces.title: Universal Command
surfaces.purpose: Floating request input; routes through MOOR.request and the singular Funnel.
surfaces.rule: Never overlaps navigation; one persistent text field, optional compact action button.

screenshotInterpretation.field: near-black spatial field with subtle depth/texture and strong empty space
screenshotInterpretation.controls: independent floating circular controls with generous spacing; selected control becomes luminous white
screenshotInterpretation.accent: ice blue/cyan outline and text; emerald only for verified/live/success
screenshotInterpretation.composition: tools hover over the world rather than living inside a dashboard shell
screenshotInterpretation.density: primary screen sparse; depth appears on demand through drawers/inspectors

navigation.mobile: top utility rail + bottom Creation Deck; Library and Inspector are edge sheets; workspace stays central
navigation.desktop: same mental model with wider Deck and dockable Library/Inspector
navigation.invariant: The same app/component is reachable from search, library, or recent deck without duplicating state.

progressiveControl: long press / context = pin, duplicate, inspect

telemetry.name: Refinery Use Telemetry
telemetry.purpose: Prove capability memory is participating in real work.
telemetry.evidenceRule: A stat increments only from a runtime event. Stored capability count is inventory, not usage.
telemetry.estimatedAvoidedReasoning: Count a request as avoided only when it resolves through verified references or a model-free assembly completes without invoking a new semantic solve.

universalValue.rule: The interface starts useful with zero personal history and compounds as the user's verified capability graph grows.
universalValue.newUser: Deck exposes starter/core apps and search; Library is small and explanatory.
universalValue.advancedUser: Deck is personal, Library scales through search/categories, Inspector exposes full contracts and provenance.
universalValue.noLLM: Verified assembly/contracts/reference reuse remain usable without an LLM.
universalValue.withLLM: The model operates on richer typed context and is invoked primarily for novel/ambiguous work.

acceptance: The request is authorized through the Ultra Funnel candidate with a valid BlueprintReceipt and ExecutionReceipt.
Pulse mobile primary view contains no permanent component grid or large dashboard panels.
Active/pinned/recent runnable apps are directly accessible from the Creation Deck.
Every component remains browseable/searchable in the Component Library.
Focused items expose full controls/provenance/assembly in the Inspector without losing underlying capability.
The universal command never overlaps the Creation Deck or safe-area.
The layout heavily reflects the screenshot's sparse floating spatial hierarchy, not merely its colors.
Refinery telemetry counts real retrieval/consumption/assembly events.
The singular Funnel receives capability/assembly/handoff references through its normal references stage.
Pulse contains a live Capability Memory view with usage stats and graph inventory.
